COMPLETED GENERATOR CHANGEOVER
PowerHub supplied the 100 A automatic transfer switch. Delta Electric separately completed the cabling and commissioning. The closeout note mentions PHP 98,000 for the combined changeover, but it does not allocate the amount between PowerHub and Delta Electric.

PowerHub delivery was included. Delta excludes future preventive maintenance. Send both invoices to accounting after approval.

human_approval.rationale: Provider split and deliberately unallocated total draft awaiting human review.
